author: Swinhoe, 1860
status: 여름철새, 해마다 수백 마리 · 겨울에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만)
habitat: 해안의 만, 하구, 간석지, 갯벌, 논
summary: 해안의 만, 하구, 간석지, 갯벌, 논 등에 사는 드문 여름철새이다. 갯벌이나 바다 가까운 습지에서 물고기, 게와 새우 같은 갑각류, 갯지렁이 따위를 주로 잡고, 썰물에 드러난 갯벌, 염전, 농경지, 저수지에서도 먹이를 찾는다. 여름에는 강화 남단 갯벌, 한강 하구, 안산 섬 지역, 안면도, 천수만 등에서 먹이를 찾는 모습이 종종 보인다. 세계 개체군의 대부분이 서해안의 무인도에서 번식한다.

points.en: long crest plumes on the head (breeding)
plumes on the neck and back (breeding)

art.subject: Chinese Egret (Egretta eulophotes), adult in breeding plumage, as seen on Korean west-coast tidal flats from May to July: plumage entirely white; a bushy, shaggy crest of many long white plumes on the nape; long lacy plumes on the back reaching past the tail, and shorter plumes on the lower foreneck. Bill bright orange-yellow; bare lores bright blue; iris yellow; legs black, feet yellow to greenish-yellow.
art.pose: walking across a tidal mudflat, hunting fish and crabs
art.scene: Korean summer west-coast tidal flats at low tide near an estuary; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding, side view standing: all-white body, bushy crest of many long nape plumes, plumes on the neck and back, orange-yellow bill, blue lores, black legs with yellow feet
adult non-breeding, side view standing: all white without plumes, blackish-brown bill with a paler yellowish base to the lower mandible, greenish-yellow legs
art.build: Medium-sized white egret, about 68cm, much smaller than a Great Egret and slightly bigger and heavier-billed than a Little Egret. Neck long and slender, held in an S-curve. Bill straight and pointed, about as long as the head, rather stout. Legs long; in the breeding season black with yellow feet, in winter greenish-yellow. Hunts actively on tidal mud, dashing and lurching with wings half-raised. At rest the wingtips reach about the tail tip. Tail short.
avoid: Do not paint a black bill with only two thin nape plumes; that is Little Egret.
Do not omit the blue facial skin on the breeding bird.
Do not paint yellow legs on the breeding bird; the legs are black and only the feet are yellow.
Do not make it Great Egret-sized with a very long kinked neck.
